annotations.title: Upload a file to your Library

description: Upload one selected image, video or audio file to the same owner upload namespace the app uses. Needs the separate manage:library grant and confirm: true after the owner approved the exact item. Pass a stable UUID uploadId, the exact SHA-256 digest of the file, a supported MIME type, and either base64 bytes or a public https sourceUrl. Upload stores bytes only: call soclo_library_finalize to obtain the durable asset id. After interruption read soclo_library_upload_status with the original uploadId; never substitute ids or repeat blindly. Debits no customer credits.

contentBase64.description: The file bytes, base64. Inline base64 must fit the full 1 MiB MCP request envelope; use sourceUrl for larger selected files.

sourceUrl.description: A public https URL to fetch the file from (no credentials, private hosts or automatic redirects to them; up to 20 MiB, matching finalization). Use instead of contentBase64 for larger files.
